libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Register org.bouncycastle.jcajce.provider.BouncyCastleFipsProvider before requesting JCA services and configure Native Image with -H:AdditionalSecurityProviders=org.bouncycastle.jcajce.provider.BouncyCastleFipsProvider. Set -Dorg.bouncycastle.native.cpu_variant=java for native-image generation and native test runtime so BC-FIPS does not extract and load its bundled x86_64 JNI libraries. Use -Djdk.util.jar.version=9 for JVM tests and -J-Djdk.util.jar.version=9 during native-image generation to consistently select the Java 9 multi-release implementation.
risks: Forcing the java CPU variant validates the JCA provider and reachability metadata but does not cover BC-FIPS native AES/SHA acceleration.
Successful execution in a native image does not by itself establish that the resulting deployment is within BC-FIPS's certified platform boundary.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: The artifact is self-contained and needs no Docker service or additional Maven dependency, but its multi-release provider and bundled JNI acceleration require explicit Native Image configuration.
